Set \(y=0\):
\[
f(x)+f(x)=2f(x)f(0)\implies f(0)=1.
\]
Set \(x=y=1\):
\[
f(2)+f(0)=2f(1)^2=2\cdot \frac14=\frac12,
\]
so
\[
f(2)=\frac12-1=-\frac12.
\]
Set \(y=1\):
\[
f(x+1)+f(x-1)=2f(x)f(1)=f(x),
\]
so for integer \(n\),
\[
f(n+1)=f(n)-f(n-1).
\]
Thus the sequence is periodic with period \(6\):
\[
1,\frac12,-\frac12,-1,-\frac12,\frac12,\ldots
\]
and each block of \(6\) terms sums to \(0\). Since
\[
2013=6\cdot 335+3,
\]
the sum is
\[
f(1)+f(2)+f(3)=\frac12-\frac12-1=-1.
\]
\[
\boxed{-1}
\]
